# SoftDesk

> AI-powered desktop software management & smart launcher for macOS and Windows.
> Open source, free, cross-platform.

## Product Summary

SoftDesk is a desktop application that helps you manage and launch software efficiently.
It scans installed applications, uses AI to automatically classify them, provides a radial
menu for quick launching via mouse middle-click, tracks usage time per app, and supports
one-click workflows to launch multiple apps together.

## Key Features

- [AI Smart Classification](/zh/features/ai-classification) - Automatically categorize apps using AI models
- [Radial Menu Launcher](/zh/features/radial-menu) - Middle-click to summon radial menu for instant app launch
- [Usage Time Tracking](/zh/features/usage-tracking) - Track per-app usage time and productivity insights
- [Cross-Platform](/zh/features/cross-platform) - Support for macOS (Intel/Apple Silicon) and Windows 10/11

## Technical Details

- Desktop Framework: Electron 31 + React 18 + TypeScript
- Local Database: better-sqlite3
- Cloud Sync: Supabase (optional)
- AI Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other configurable providers
- License: Open Source
